affected_party: QIF pilot operators, evidence custodians, and accountable reviewers
actual_problem: QIF can register an empirical outcome observation but cannot preserve how that observation changes over time without overwriting prior state
why_it_matters: Late outcomes, source corrections, and custody transfers can silently rewrite the evidence used for calibration, destroying auditability and making corrected data look originally known
why_now: v0.7.0 made prospective pilots startable; current evaluation practice distinguishes environment outcomes from claims and requires production monitoring, human calibration, missing-data restraint, and provenance
